themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and take actions in research contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focusing on AI tools and techniques that assist developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles about specific AI platforms, software, and tools designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discussions around AI-generated personas or synthetic data used to simulate user behavior for testing and research.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, or assess the performance and utility of various AI tools.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Content examining how AI is affecting jobs, employment, skills, and the future of work.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Articles on how AI is being applied to product development, strategy, and management processes.

themes.name: Conversational AI in research
themes.description: Content related to using AI chatbots and conversational interfaces for user interviews, data collection, and research interaction.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Articles focusing on comprehensive platforms and ecosystems built to support and facilitate AI-driven research.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
